topic: An artist discovers someone has tattooed their work
text: I found out someone inked my art onto their skin without so much as a nod in my direction. No permission, not a single credit, nothing. Now there’s a permanent mark on someone, an echo of my creativity, with no acknowledgment of where it came from. I poured hours, days, into that piece, every line, every color, a reflection of my vision, and this person just took it, like it was theirs to claim. It’s out there now, twisted into something that’s supposed to represent me, but doesn’t.
